method: Independent human-style clause-by-clause reading of the distributed full source, selected source and complete reference; factual units are grouped for readability, not model-scored.
not_claimed: Reference statements grounded in prior/amended law are not claimed to be literally entailed by the displayed source, nor independently verified against every prior statute.
